transport: PostgREST RPC (supabase.rpc(name, args)); errors arrive as {code:'P0001', message:'RC04_<CODE>: text'} — the code is the prefix before ':'
identity: actor is always auth.uid(); no actor id is accepted from the client

value_states.scored: score 0..max (0 is a real score), outcome pass (score >= MPL) | fail | null when criteria missing
value_states.unknown: no data yet (initial state); blocks review/publish

overall_rules: unknown cell or missing MPL → not_ready (Admin draft only; cannot be published)
any absent/awaiting → incomplete (+ failed_part_ids if any)
fingerprints: sha256 hex of jsonb text; delta fingerprint covers exam_id, revision_id, version and the sorted normalized delta
receipts: actor+operation+request_id unique; INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (an identical in-flight request waits, then replays); committed receipts never purged in v1

errors.RC04_FORBIDDEN: caller is not the required active role (checked before any receipt/preview lookup)
errors.RC04_INVALID_INPUT: malformed or out-of-range input (message says which)
errors.RC04_LIMIT: size limit exceeded (roster 1-200 also after update, 50 parts, 10 000 cells)
errors.RC04_NOT_FOUND: exam/revision not found for this caller (also for drafts guessed by id)
errors.RC04_NOT_WORKING: only the working revision can change
errors.RC04_REVISION_CONFLICT: expected_version is not the current version (new request on old template/preview)
errors.RC04_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: same request_id with a different payload
errors.RC04_PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND: preview does not exist or belongs to another Admin
errors.RC04_PREVIEW_CONSUMED: preview already committed by another request
errors.RC04_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: preview older than 30 min or invalidated by a change
errors.RC04_REASON_REQUIRED: change overwrites recorded values / correction / roster removal without reason
errors.RC04_SCORE_EXCEEDS_NEW_MAX: new max below a recorded score
errors.RC04_NOT_READY: validation blockers (UNKNOWN_CELLS, CRITERIA_MISSING, SCORE_EXCEEDS_MAX, MPL_EXCEEDS_MAX, EMPTY_ROSTER_OR_PARTS)
errors.RC04_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: confirm.absent/awaiting differ from the current counts (P01)
errors.RC04_NOT_REVIEWED: publish without review of this exact version
errors.RC04_PUBLISHED_REVISION_CONFLICT: expected_published_revision_id is not current / correction base changed
errors.RC04_WORKING_REVISION_EXISTS: only one working revision per exam
errors.RC04_READ_SET_NOT_FOUND: read set unknown or owned by another user
errors.RC04_READ_SET_EXPIRED: read set older than 30 min: restart the whole read
errors.RC04_INVALID_CURSOR: cursor not exactly {manifest_id,i,r,s,p} with right types/range, or from another read set
errors.RC04_MANAGED_EXAM: legacy writer / direct write on a managed exam refused
errors.RC04_IMMUTABLE: published revision rows / audit cannot change

operations.name: rc04_create_managed_exam

p_payload.title: text 1-160
p_payload.roster: [{resident_id uuid (Resident account), pgy_at_exam 1-4 (confirmed), reference_name text optional (default profile name at creation)}] 1-200, unique
p_payload.parts: [{name text 1-120, sort_order 1-50 unique, max_score > 0, mpl {"<pgy>": numeric 0..max} optional}] 1-50

operations.notes: all-or-nothing; every roster x part cell is created as unknown; profile PGY is not touched

operations.name: rc04_update_working_revision

args.p_changes: {title?, exam_date?, academic_year?, participants?:[{resident_id, pgy_at_exam?, reference_name?}], add_participants?:[{resident_id, pgy_at_exam, reference_name?}], remove_participants?:[uuid], parts?:[{part_id, name?, max_score?, mpl?:{"<pgy>": numeric|null(null deletes)}}]}
args.p_reason: text <=300, required when removing a resident with recorded results

operations.notes: final roster must be 1-200 after all removes/adds of the request (RC04_LIMIT otherwise, whole request rolled back). Only values that really change after normalization count: if none changes → {noop:true}, version/review/previews kept (still needs the right expected_version). A real change bumps version, clears review, expires previews, recomputes outcomes. remove+add of the same resident is a real change (results restart as unknown). Working revision only.

returns.exam: {exam_id, revision_id, revision_seq, version, state, academic_year, exam_date, exam_type, title}
returns.parts: [{part_id, column_key 'part_<sort>', name, sort_order, max_score, mpl {pgy: mpl}}] by sort_order

operations.name: rc04_preview_import
operations.mutation: writes a preview row only, never results

p_cells.state: 'scored'|'absent'|'awaiting' (unknown cannot be imported; blank cells are simply not sent)
p_cells.score: JSON number, 0..max_score, <= 2 decimals; only with state=scored
p_cells.cell_ref: text, optional (e.g. 'D5'), echoed in errors/diff; not an identity

args.p_file_evidence: jsonb (e.g. {file_hash, file_name}) stored with the preview/batch

p_file_reported.nullable: SQL NULL / omitted / JSON null over HTTP = no file metadata sent (accepted; proves nothing about an XLSX)

optional.roster: array (not null) of {resident_id string uuid, pgy_at_exam integer, cell_ref string|null optional}; partial list allowed; each must equal the snapshot; no duplicates
optional.parts: array (not null) of {part_id string uuid, max_score number, mpl object {"1".."4": number}, cell_ref string|null optional}; partial list allowed; max and the FULL mpl map of each listed part must equal the snapshot; no duplicates

p_file_reported.errors: FILE_REPORTED_NOT_OBJECT, FILE_REPORTED_MISSING_KEY, FILE_REPORTED_NULL, FILE_REPORTED_WRONG_TYPE, FILE_REPORTED_UNKNOWN_KEY, FILE_REPORTED_DUPLICATE, then value mismatches TEMPLATE_VERSION_MISMATCH, EXAM_MISMATCH, REVISION_MISMATCH, TEMPLATE_OUTDATED, ACADEMIC_YEAR_MISMATCH, ROSTER_OR_PGY_MISMATCH, PART_OR_CRITERIA_MISMATCH — any error → ok=false, no preview
p_file_reported.server_checks: types/nulls/keys above; ids, version, year, roster PGY, part max and MPL against the server snapshot; never writes PGY or MPL
p_file_reported.parser_gate_C0: XLSX type/size/ZIP limits, sheets and headers present, macros/external links/formulas refused, numeric cells only, blank → not sent, reference_name, part name/order and part-column mapping compared with rc04_get_import_template; SQL fixtures are not workbook tests

returns.diff: [{resident_id, part_id, cell_ref, overwrites_recorded_value, before{value_state,score,outcome}, after{value_state,score,outcome(predicted)}}] changed cells only
returns.errors: [{code, cell_ref, resident_id, part_id}] codes: INVALID_ID, UNKNOWN_RESIDENT, UNKNOWN_PART, DUPLICATE_CELL, INVALID_STATE, INVALID_SCORE_TYPE, SCORE_NEGATIVE, SCORE_EXCEEDS_MAX, SCORE_TOO_PRECISE, STATE_WITH_SCORE, TEMPLATE_VERSION_MISMATCH, EXAM_MISMATCH, REVISION_MISMATCH, TEMPLATE_OUTDATED, ACADEMIC_YEAR_MISMATCH, ROSTER_OR_PGY_MISMATCH, PART_OR_CRITERIA_MISMATCH

operations.notes: ok=false → no preview row; any error rejects the whole file

operations.name: rc04_commit_import
operations.notes: merges only the previewed cells; no-op keeps version and review; replay returns the first result before any stale check

operations.name: rc04_publish_revision
operations.notes: revision becomes immutable; pointer + events projection (title/date/type/status) change in the same transaction

operations.name: rc04_begin_correction
operations.notes: clone of the exact published revision (same part_ids); readers keep the old one until publish

operations.name: rc04_admin_list_exams
operations.returns: [{exam_id, published_revision_id, published{...}|null, working{revision_id, seq, version, reviewed, academic_year, exam_date, title, base_published_revision_id, validation}|null}]

operations.name: rc04_open_read_set
operations.role: own: Active Resident; staff: Active Staff or Admin

args.p_revision_id: uuid|null (older PUBLISHED revision of p_exam_id; drafts → NOT_FOUND)

returns.entries: [{exam_id, revision_id, revision_seq, academic_year, exam_date, title, exam_type, published_at, is_current}] ordered academic_year desc, exam_date desc, exam_id

operations.name: rc04_read_page
operations.role: same as the read set, re-checked on every page; owner of the manifest only

args.p_cursor: SQL NULL (or null over HTTP) = first page; otherwise exactly {manifest_id string uuid of this read set, i integer 0..entries-1, r string uuid, s integer, p string uuid} — anything else → RC04_INVALID_CURSOR (checked before any query); always pass next_cursor unchanged

returns.rows: [{entry_index, exam_id, revision_id, revision_seq, academic_year, exam_date, title, exam_type, resident_id, reference_name, pgy_at_exam, part_id, part_name, part_sort_order, max_score, mpl|null, criteria_status 'complete'|'missing', value_state, score|null, outcome 'pass'|'fail'|null, overall{status 'all_passed'|'failed_some'|'incomplete'|'not_ready', failed_part_ids, absent_part_ids, awaiting_part_ids, unknown_part_ids, criteria_missing_part_ids}}] ordered entry_index, resident_id, part_sort_order, part_id

operations.notes: rows with null score/outcome (absent/awaiting) are always returned; the pinned revision never changes inside a read set; expired/foreign read set → restart the whole read and discard partial data

changes_from_v1: B01 final roster 1-200 checked in rc04_update_working_revision
B03 update no-op when no value really changes
nullability_over_http: PostgREST passes a JSON null argument as SQL NULL. For p_file_reported and p_cursor, null/omitted therefore means 'not sent' (first page / no file metadata). A JSON null VALUE inside an object is a real null and is validated.
audit_scope: revision.update audit stores changed_keys, items and before/after version (not the old values). Immutable published revisions are full snapshots; intermediate working states cannot be rebuilt from the audit.
